Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh visit Siddhivinayak Temple

Actors Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh visited the Siddhivinayak Temple in Mumbai. The visit occurred before the birth of their second child. Padukone had also visited the temple during her first pregnancy.
